snippet.title: Draftfall — Official Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Draftfall is OUT NOW on Steam!

You draft. Jake fights. Build your hero, rebuild Levona, and take on tougher challenges in New Game+.

Get the full game—or try the free demo. https://store.steampowered.com/app/5058410/Draftfall/

Which would you build: devastating damage or an unbreakable survivor?

#Draftfall #IndieGame #AutoBattler #Deckbuilder #PCGaming
